d.ko: DIRT 5 is a fun, amplified, off-road arcade racing experience created by Codemasters. Blaze a trail on routes across the world, covering gravel, ice, snow and sand, with a roster of cars ranging from rally icons to trucks, to GT heroes.
d.en: DIRT 5 is a fun, amplified, off-road arcade racing experience created by Codemasters. Blaze a trail on routes across the world, covering gravel, ice, snow and sand, with a roster of cars ranging from rally icons to trucks, to GT heroes.
d.zh: 在DIRT 5中尽情释放自我——有史以来最大胆的越野赛体验，明星云集的职业生涯，四人分屏模式，创新的在线模式，涂装编辑器以及更多精彩内容。驾驶着经典拉力赛车或是卡车亦或是GT英雄车，在遍及全球覆盖碎石、冰、雪和沙子的各种赛道上驰骋。
